(909-628-3445) Get a Free Quotation Corporate Overview JM Fiber Optics was established in 1992 as a full service communications company. Our experience allows us to present simplified choices and bring high-tech solutions into a cost-effective reality. With over 30 years of experience in the fiber optics industry, we have the technical expertise, highly trained staff, and financial stability to meet the requirements of your project. In fact, JM Fiber Optics is the only MBE firm to be twice awarded Minority Business of the Year in Technology from the City of Los Angeles. We are an approved Department of Defense supplier/contractor and listed on Central Contractors Registration. Certifications for individual states are available upon request. subpages.title: Communication Transport Networks - JM Fiber Optics
subpages.desc: At JM Fiber Optics, we work together with you to create a unique, optimal network solution for years to come.
subpages.text: About Us Services System Integration Communication Transport Networks Training Projects Contact Us SERVICING CUSTOMERS SINCE 1992 How can we help you? (909-628-3445) Get a Free Quotation Communication Transport Networks At JM Fiber Optics, it is our priority to understand your wide area networking needs. This begins by listening to you. Your input provides us with a baseline we can use to source from our multi-vendor technology and expertise. In the end, we will work together with you to create a unique, optimal network solution for years to come. Our recommendation in designing a new network or upgrading an existing one, is to centralize all of your mission critical circuits and subsystems on to one highly reliable network. This will allow you to efficiently manage bandwidth and guarantee quality of service for current and future applications. To achieve this, we use network protocols transported over over fiber optics, WiFi and cellular. They include: Redundant Layer 2 & 3 Switching and Routing Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS) Optical Transport Network Carrier Ethernet DWDM We only utilize the highest quality network equipment from industry leading manufacturers. This gives you the piece of mind knowing your network was designed and built using the best equipment and technical support available. These companies include, but are not limited to: Find out why major government agency’s and commercial enterprises across the country look to JM Fiber Optics for their integrated network solutions! (909-628-3445) Get a Free Quotation At JM Fiber Optics, we are much more then a cabling contractor. We employ qualified personnel who have the innate ability to understand our client needs. They are skilled at interpreting technical requirements and translating them into the appropriate solution. We do this from project documentation, and by studying your processes. Moreover, we identify project improvement opportunities to help reduce costs and improve overall performance. We will spend a great deal of time asking questions and seeking to learn about your firms needs. Most importantly, we listen! We look out for your needs even if you are unsure how to best articulate what you seek. JM Fiber Optics employees a full time BICSI RCDD and our fiber technicians are certified by ETA® International. We follow the guidelines of MIL , TIA , ANSI & IEEE standards for each installation and repair. By utilizing over 30 years of fiber optic network experience, we go well beyond what a typical contractor or systems integrator can offer.
